entities.name: Dark Maze
entities.description: Misty maze phenomenon of Ulgrotha that thinks and hunts like a creature; maze-elementals frequent the area around Castle Sengir.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane where the Dark Mazes are found.

entities.name: Dark Barony
entities.description: Territory whose villagers find corpses torn apart after foggy nights.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Vampire who disguised himself as a mysterious stranger and gave a young man the books summoning the maze creatures.

entities.name: Floating Island
entities.description: Place where the maze creatures were created.

entities.name: Aysen
entities.description: People of the Floating Island; a bureaucrat's son summoned the creatures.

events.summary: The son of an Aysen bureaucrat, given special books by Baron Sengir in disguise, summons maze creatures and is destroyed by them.
events.quote: who was Baron Sengir in disguise
